	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,
								1,
								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

		}

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']==1 AND $StandardCost !=0){

/*first the cost of sales entry - GL accounts are retrieved using the function GetCOGSGLAccount from includes/GetSalesTransGLCodes.php  */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . GetCOGSGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']) . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . ($StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*now the stock entry - this is set to the cost act in the case of a fixed asset disposal */
			$StockGLCode = GetStockGLCode($OrderLineRow['stkcode']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $StockGLCode['stockact'] . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . (-$StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} /* end of if GL and stock integrated and standard cost !=0  and not an asset */

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] !=0){

			//Post sales transaction to GL credit sales
			$SalesGLAccounts = GetSalesGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount )
				VALUES ('10',
					'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $SalesGLAccounts['salesglcode'] . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] . "',
					'" . -$OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "'
				)";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			if ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] !=0){

				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount)
						VALUES (10,
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $SalesGLAccounts['discountglcode'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " @ " . ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * 100) . "%',
							'" . ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['discountpercent']/$OrderHeader['rate']) . "')";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /*end of if discount !=0 */

		} /*end of if sales integrated with gl */

		$LineCounter++; //needed for the array of taxes by line
	} /*end of OrderLine loop */

	$TotalInvLocalCurr = ($TotalFXNetInvoice + $TotalFXTax)/$OrderHeader['rate'];

	if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1){

		/*Now post the tax to the GL at local currency equivalent */
		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $TaxAuthAmount !=0) {

			/*Loop through the tax authorities array to post each total to the taxauth glcode */
			foreach ($TaxTotals as $Tax){
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount )
										VALUES (10,
										'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
										'" . $OrderHeader['orddate']. "',
										'" . $PeriodNo . "',
										'" . $Tax['GLCode'] . "',
										'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "-" . $Tax['TaxAuthDescription'] . "',
										'" . -$Tax['FXAmount']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "' )";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			}
		}

		/*Post debtors transaction to GL debit debtors, credit freight re-charged and credit sales */
		if (($TotalInvLocalCurr) !=0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES ('10',
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $CompanyRecord['debtorsact'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
									'" . $TotalInvLocalCurr . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(10,$InvoiceNo);

	} /*end of if Sales and GL integrated */

/*Update order header for invoice charged on */
	$SQL = "UPDATE salesorders SET comments = CONCAT(comments,' Inv ','" . $InvoiceNo . "') WHERE orderno= '" . $OrderNo . "'";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*Now insert the DebtorTrans */

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									order_,
									ovamount,
									ovgst,
									rate,
									shipvia,
									salesperson)
								VALUES (
									'". $InvoiceNo . "',
									10,
									'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H-i-s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['customerref'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "',
									'" . $OrderNo . "',
									'" . $TotalFXNetInvoice . "',
									'" . $TotalFXTax . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['shipvia'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['salesman'] . "')";

	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id');

	/*for each Tax - need to insert into debtortranstaxes */
	foreach ($TaxTotals AS $TaxAuthID => $Tax) {

		$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortranstaxes (debtortransid,
											taxauthid,
											taxamount)
							VALUES ('" . $DebtorTransID . "',
									'" . $TaxAuthID . "',
									'" . $Tax['FXAmount']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "')";
		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
	}

	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {

		DB_Txn_Commit();
		$Errors[0]=0;
		$Errors[1]=$InvoiceNo;
	} else {
		DB_Txn_Rollback();
	}
	return $Errors;
} //end InvoiceSalesOrder function


function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

/** Modify a customer sales order line in webERP. The order header must
 * already exist in webERP.
 */
function ModifySalesOrderLine($OrderLine, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	foreach ($OrderLine as $key => $Value) {
		$OrderLine[$key] = DB_escape_string($Value);
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderLine['orderno'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	$Errors=VerifyStockCodeExists($OrderLine['stkcode'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (isset($OrderLine['unitprice'])){
		$Errors=VerifyUnitPrice($OrderLine['unitprice'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['quantity'])){
		$Errors=VerifyQuantity($OrderLine['quantity'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['discountpercent'])){
		//$OrderLine['discountpercent'] = $OrderLine['discountpercent'] * 100;
		$Errors=VerifyDiscountPercent($OrderLine['discountpercent'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
		$OrderLine['discountpercent'] = $OrderLine['discountpercent']/100;
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['narrative'])){
		$Errors=VerifyNarrative($OrderLine['narrative'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['itemdue'])){
		$Errors=VerifyItemDueDate($OrderLine['itemdue'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['poline'])){
		$Errors=VerifyPOLine($OrderLine['poline'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	$SQL='UPDATE salesorderdetails SET ';
	foreach ($OrderLine as $key => $Value) {
		if ($key == 'actualdispatchdate') {
			$Value = FormatDateWithTimeForSQL($Value);
		}
		elseif ($key == 'itemdue')
			$Value = FormatDateForSQL($Value);
		$SQL .= $key.'="'.$Value.'", ';
	}
	//$SQL = mb_substr($SQL,0,-2).' WHERE orderno="'.$OrderLine['orderno'].'" and
		//	" orderlineno='.$OrderLine['orderlineno'];
	$SQL = mb_substr($SQL,0,-2)." WHERE orderno='" . $OrderLine['orderno']."' AND stkcode='" . $OrderLine['stkcode']."'";
			//echo $SQL;
			//exit();
	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {
		$Result = api_DB_Query($SQL);
		echo DB_error_no();
		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[0] = DatabaseUpdateFailed;
		} else {
			$Errors[0]=0;
		}
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** This function takes a Order Header ID  and returns an associative array containing
   the database record for that Order. If the Order Header ID doesn't exist
   then it returns an $Errors array.
*/
function GetSalesOrderValue($OrderNo, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	//$SQL="SELECT * FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='".$OrderNo."'";
		$SQL = "SELECT salesorders.orderno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					custbranch.brname,
					salesorders.customerref,
					salesorders.orddate,
					salesorders.deliverydate,
					salesorders.deliverto,
					salesorders.printedpackingslip,
					salesorders.poplaced,
					SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice*(salesorderdetails.quantity-salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced)*(1-salesorderdetails.discountpercent)/currencies.rate) as ordervalue,
					pickreq.prid
				FROM salesorders
				INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
					ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
				INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
					ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
				INNER JOIN custbranch
					ON debtorsmaster.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
					and salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
				LEFT OUTER JOIN pickreq
					ON pickreq.orderno = salesorders.orderno
					and pickreq.closed = 0
				WHERE salesorderdetails.completed = 0 and salesorders.orderno='".$OrderNo."'";
	$Result = api_DB_Query($SQL);
	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {
		return DB_fetch_array($Result);
	} else {
		return $Errors;
	}
}

function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/* credit control: nothing is invoiced for a customer on stop, or on an order held for credit control, until credit control releases the order */
	include_once($PathPrefix . 'includes/CreditControlFunctions.php');
	$CreditResult = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
	$CreditRow = DB_fetch_row($CreditResult);
	$CreditCheck = CreditControlInvoiceCheck($OrderNo, $CreditRow[0]);
	if ($CreditCheck['result'] == 'stop') {
		$Errors[] = CustomerOnCreditStop;
		return $Errors;
	} elseif ($CreditCheck['result'] == 'held') {
		$Errors[] = OrderHeldForCreditControl;
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

function InsertSalesOrderLine($OrderLine, $user, $password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	foreach ($OrderLine as $key => $Value) {
		$OrderLine[$key] = DB_escape_string($Value);
	}
	$OrderLine['orderlineno'] = GetOrderLineNumber($OrderLine['orderno'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderLine['orderno'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	$Errors=VerifyStockCodeExists($OrderLine['stkcode'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (isset($OrderLine['unitprice'])){
		$Errors=VerifyUnitPrice($OrderLine['unitprice'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['quantity'])){
		$Errors=VerifyQuantity($OrderLine['quantity'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['discountpercent'])){
		//$OrderLine['discountpercent'] = $OrderLine['discountpercent'] * 100;
		$Errors=VerifyDiscountPercent($OrderLine['discountpercent'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
		$OrderLine['discountpercent'] = $OrderLine['discountpercent']/100;
	}
	if (isset($OrderLine['narrative'])){
		$Errors=VerifyNarrative($OrderLine['narrative'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	// Not sure why the verification of itemdue doesn't work
	/*
	if (isset($OrderLine['itemdue'])){
		$Errors=VerifyItemDueDate($OrderLine['itemdue'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	*/
	if (isset($OrderLine['poline'])){
		$Errors=VerifyPOLine($OrderLine['poline'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	$FieldNames='';
	$FieldValues='';
	foreach ($OrderLine as $key => $Value) {
		$FieldNames.=$key.', ';
		if ($key == 'actualdispatchdate') {
			$Value = FormatDateWithTimeForSQL($Value);
		} elseif ($key == 'itemdue') {
			$Value = FormatDateForSQL($Value);
		}
		$FieldValues.= "'" . $Value . "', ";
	}

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesorderdetails (" . mb_substr($FieldNames,0,-2) . ")
		VALUES (" . mb_substr($FieldValues,0,-2) . ")";

	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {
		/* credit control: refuse lines on an order of a customer on stop, hold the order when the lines take the customer over their limit */
		include_once(__DIR__ . '/../../includes/CreditControlFunctions.php');
		$CreditResult = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, quotation FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderLine['orderno'] . "'");
		$CreditRow = DB_fetch_array($CreditResult);
		if ($CreditRow['quotation'] == 0) {
			$CreditCheck = CreditControlOrderCheck($CreditRow['debtorno'], 0, $OrderLine['orderno']);
			if ($CreditCheck['result'] == 'stop') {
				$Errors[0] = CustomerOnCreditStop;
				return $Errors;
			}
		}
		$Result = api_DB_Query($SQL);
		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[0] = DatabaseUpdateFailed;
		} else {
			$Errors[0]=0;
			if ($CreditRow['quotation'] == 0) {
				$CreditCheck = CreditControlOrderCheck($CreditRow['debtorno'], CreditControlOrderOutstanding($OrderLine['orderno']), $OrderLine['orderno']);
				if ($CreditCheck['result'] == 'hold') {
					CreditControlHoldOrder($OrderLine['orderno'], $CreditRow['debtorno'], __('Order held, it takes the customer over their credit limit'));
					$Errors[1] = OrderHeldForCreditControl;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return $Errors;
}

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,

/*now the stock entry - this is set to the cost act in the case of a fixed asset disposal */

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

/** Insert a new customer in the webERP database. This function takes an
   associative array called $CustomerDetails, where the keys are the
   names of the fields in the debtorsmaster table, and the values are the
   values to insert. The only mandatory fields are the debtorno, name,
   currency code, sales type, payment terms, and reason code
   fields. If the other fields aren't set, then the database defaults
   are used. The function returns an array called $Errors. The database
   is only updated if the $Errors is empty, else the function returns an
   array of one to many error codes.
*/
function InsertCustomer($CustomerDetails, $user = '', $password = '') {

		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;

	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['address6'])){

	}

	if (isset($CustomerDetails['salestype'])){
		$Errors=VerifySalesType($CustomerDetails['salestype'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['clientsince'])){
		$Errors=VerifyClientSince($CustomerDetails['clientsince'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['holdreason'])){
		$Errors=VerifyHoldReason($CustomerDetails['holdreason'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['paymentterms'])){
		$Errors=VerifyPaymentTerms($CustomerDetails['paymentterms'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);

	if (isset($CustomerDetails['ediorders'])){

	if (isset($CustomerDetails['edireference'])){

	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['editransport'])){

	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['ediserveruser'])){

	$FieldNames='';
	$FieldValues='';
	foreach ($CustomerDetails as $key => $Value) {
		$FieldNames.=$key.', ';
		$FieldValues.='"'.$Value.'", ';
	}
	$SQL = 'INSERT INTO debtorsmaster ('.mb_substr($FieldNames,0,-2).') '.
	  'VALUES ('.mb_substr($FieldValues,0,-2).') ';
	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[0] = DatabaseUpdateFailed;
		} else {
			$Errors[0]=0;
		}
	}
	return $Errors;
}

   the database record for that debtor. If the debtor number doesn't exist
   then it returns an $Errors array.
*/
function GetCustomer($DebtorNumber, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors = VerifyDebtorExists($DebtorNumber, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL="SELECT * FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='".$DebtorNumber."'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Errors[0] = 0; // None found.
	$Errors[1] = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	return $Errors;
}

   array of debtornos that fulfill this criteria.
*/
function SearchCustomers($Field, $Criteria, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL='SELECT debtorno
		FROM debtorsmaster
		WHERE '.$Field." LIKE '%".$Criteria."%'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$DebtorList = array(0);	    // First element: no errors
	while ($MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$DebtorList[]=$MyRow[0];
	}
	return $DebtorList;
}

Credit Status Ratings

Each customer can be given a credit status that describes the risk as assessed by the credit controller, attached to invoices to the customer. This will never appear on any reports to customers. The customer selection screen allows customers to be restricted by their credit status so it is easy to perform inquiries on all the customers with a similar credit status. In addition the system will not allow invoices to customers whose credit status has a check in the field to prohibit invoicing. This is another credit control tool to the credit limit.

Credit Status Ratings can be amended and created from the main menu set up tab from the link labelled Credit Status Maintenance.

Status Code

This is any number from 1 to 100. A rating code is required to be held against every customer to identify the credit status of each. The code cannot be changed retrospectively.

Status Description

This field is used in look ups both in the customers amendment/entry and also in the customer selection screen. This is a text field up to 30 characters long.

Disallow Invoices

For all credit ratings set up, this field indicates whether or not the rating is serious enough to prohibit future invoicing to customers set up with this credit rating.

input.content:
Credit Control

Credit control applies the same rules to every customer every time, and keeps a history of what was decided, by whom and when. It covers credit reviews, putting customers on stop or on watch, overdue reminder letters, month end interest and late fees, and writing off bad debts. A customer's credit status is the credit status rating held on the customer record (see Credit Status Ratings) so the stop list is the same list the sales office, the web shop, electronic orders and standing orders all use.

Credit control actions need the security token Credit control (21), given by default to the Accountant and System Administrator roles. Approving a write-off over the approval limit needs the token Credit control approval (22), given by default to the System Administrator role. Give these tokens to the roles used by the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director. Everyone else, including sales reps and the sales office, can see the credit information of the customers they are allowed to see but cannot change a credit limit or a credit status. A sales rep sees only the customers assigned to them.

Credit reviews

From the customer selection screen choose Credit Review and History, or use Credit Reviews and Stop/Watch in the accounts receivable transactions menu. The page shows the customer's status, credit limit, balance, overdue amount, the last reminder stage sent and the next review date. Recording a review records the date, who did it, the outcome (limit confirmed, raised, reduced, put on watch, put on stop, taken off watch or stop), the new credit limit, notes and the next review date. If the review changes the limit the customer's limit is changed at the same time, so the limit and the reason for it are always recorded together. Reviews cannot be changed or deleted. The page also lists every review and everything else credit control has done for the customer.

Every customer has a next review date. A new customer gets one automatically, one standard review period (set in the Credit Control Setup, normally 12 months) after the account is opened. When the system is first upgraded every existing customer is given a date one review period away. Customers with a date within the days chosen on the credit control report are listed as due.

Stop and watch

A customer on stop cannot be supplied by any route. No order can be entered in the sales office, placed through the web shop, received electronically or raised from a standing order, and goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced on orders taken before the stop, unless credit control releases the order from the credit control report. The reason is recorded when the customer is put on stop and when they are taken off. A customer on watch can still be supplied but everyone taking an order for them is warned, and credit control can see their orders on the credit control report. The customer is not told that they are on watch. The web shop shows a customer on stop that their account is on hold and that they should contact us.

An order that takes a customer over their credit limit is accepted but held for credit control. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it. This needs the system parameter Check Credit Limits to be set to warn or prohibit (it is not applied if it is turned off).

The credit status ratings that put customers on watch or on stop are set up in Credit Status Maintenance. Each rating says what it does: supply as normal, put on watch, or put on stop.

An invoice or charge can be marked as disputed on the credit review page. A disputed item is not chased and does not attract interest until the dispute is settled.

Customers can be exempted from reminder letters, interest or late fees on the credit review page, with a reason.

Overdue reminder letters

Finance sets the number of reminder stages, the days overdue that trigger each, and the wording of each letter, in the Credit Control Setup. The words {name}, {debtorno}, {company}, {currency}, {amount} and {invoices} in the wording are replaced for each customer. The standard stages are a polite reminder, a firmer second letter and a final notice.

The reminder run is started by credit control from Overdue Reminder Run, normally weekly. It first shows who will get which letter. Untick the customers who should be left out this time, for example where a payment has been promised, then send. A customer moves up one stage at a time, and only while still overdue by the days set for the next stage. A customer who has paid the invoices they were reminded about starts again at stage 1. A customer is not sent a letter inside the least number of days between letters set in the setup. Disputed invoices are not chased. Letters go by email to the customer's contacts flagged to receive statements. Customers with no email address are listed with their letter text so that it can be printed and posted. Each letter sent is recorded against the customer, with the date, the stage, the invoices it covered and the amount, and the customer can see it in the customer portal. The setup can also put a customer on stop automatically when the final notice is sent.

Month end interest and late fees

Finance sets in the Credit Control Setup an annual interest rate, a late fee, and the number of days an invoice must be overdue before it is charged. The general ledger accounts for the interest and fee income are chosen in Company Preferences. At month end use Month End Interest and Late Fees. It shows what will be charged to whom. Interest is one twelfth of the annual rate on invoices overdue by more than the grace days (interest is not charged on interest or fees), and the fee is charged once per customer per month, converted to the customer's currency. Confirm the list to post the charges. Each charge is a customer transaction in the customer's own currency, shown on the account and the next statement as Interest and Late Fee Charge, and it is posted to the general ledger. A customer is never charged twice for the same month. A charge can be waived, with a reason. The waiver is allocated to the charge and reverses the general ledger entries.

Bad Debt Write-offs writes off all or part of a customer's unpaid invoices and charges, with a reason. The write-off reduces the customer's balance (it is allocated to the oldest items first) and is posted to the bad debts account chosen in Company Preferences, with any exchange rate difference posted to the sales exchange variances account. A write-off above the approval limit set in the Credit Control Setup does nothing until the Finance Director approves it on the same page. The customer is put on stop automatically unless the box is unticked. A debt that is paid after it has been written off is entered as an ordinary receipt and shows on the customer account as an unallocated receipt. The Bad Debt Write-offs Report lists the write-offs over a period.

The credit control report lists the customers due or overdue for a credit review, the customers over their credit limit and by how much, the customers on watch or on stop, and the orders held for credit control, taken before a stop or taken for customers on watch. The Debtors Control Reconciliation report compares the customer accounts with the debtors control account in the general ledger by transaction type, so that if they do not agree the type of posting that caused the difference can be seen. It also lists entries on the control account with no customer transaction behind them, such as manual journals, and customer transactions with no entry on the control account. Interest, fees, waivers and write-offs are customer transactions and post to the ledger by themselves so no manual journals are needed.

Notes for sales staff

A customer shown On Watch can still be supplied. When you take an order for them you will see a warning. Talk to the customer before they order if you can. A customer shown On Stop cannot be supplied. The order screen will not accept an order and goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced. Do not promise delivery. Contact credit control. If an order you enter takes a customer over their credit limit it is accepted but held until credit control releases it. You can see a customer's status, reason, limit, balance, overdue amounts and reminders for your own customers but you cannot change them.

1	# webERP test harness: installer, anonymous/logged-in page access and XML-RPC API tests (`webERP/tests`)
2	
3	Part of [webERP installer, seed data, schema, build/CI and project-history area](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	The topic is a PHPUnit suite that drives a running webERP over HTTP (Symfony HttpBrowser, PhpXmlRpc client). It covers the installer wizard, anonymous and logged-in page access, and the XML-RPC API at `/api/api_xml-rpc.php`. It reads the webERP source tree on disk to list pages, and it connects to the test database over mysqli. It takes its configuration from `$_ENV`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	- **Environment keys read:**
9	  - Target: `TEST_TARGET_PROTOCOL`, `TEST_TARGET_HOSTNAME`, `TEST_TARGET_PORT`, `TEST_TARGET_BASE_URL`.
10	  - Database: `TEST_DB_TYPE`, `TEST_DB_HOSTNAME`, `TEST_DB_USER`, `TEST_DB_PASSWORD`, `TEST_DB_SCHEMA`, `TEST_DB_PORT`.
11	  - User: `TEST_USER_ACCOUNT`, `TEST_USER_PASSWORD`.
12	  - Failure output: `TEST_ERROR_SCREENSHOTS_DIR`.
13	- **Installer form fields, taken from `$_ENV`** (the keys are not shown, only the test function's calls):
14	  - Page 3 form `test`: dbms, HostName, Port, Database, UserName, Password.
15	  - Page 4 form `test`: adminaccount, Email, webERPPassword, PasswordConfirm.
16	  - Page 5 form `install`: CompanyName='Acme', COA='sql/coa/en_GB.utf8.sql', TimeZone='Europe/London', Demo='Yes'. LogoFile is removed before submit.
17	- **Login form `SubmitUser`:** CompanyNameField=`TEST_DB_SCHEMA`, UserNameEntryField=`TEST_USER_ACCOUNT`, Password=`TEST_USER_PASSWORD`.
18	- **Config check:** `GET {baseUri}/tests/setup/php_config_check.php?phpunit_rand_id=<randId>`.
19	  - The suite writes `randId` to `sys_get_temp_dir()/phpunit_rand_id.txt`.

  - Page 4 form `test`: adminaccount, Email, webERPPassword, PasswordConfirm.
  - Page 5 form `install`: CompanyName='Acme', COA='sql/coa/en_GB.utf8.sql', TimeZone='Europe/London', Demo='Yes'. LogoFile is removed before submit.

# Credit control: what was built, what else changed, and why

Nothing could be run here (no shell, no database), so none of this has been executed. It was written against the code and the project map. It needs a run on the demo database and on a fresh install before it ships (see "Not verified" at the end).

## The main design decision: the credit status is the existing hold reason

webERP already has a credit status: `debtorsmaster.holdreason` pointing at `holdreasons`, and `holdreasons.dissallowinvoices` says what it does. The order pages, counter sales, special orders, contracts and the customer pages already read it (1 stops, 2 means "watch" and warns). `CreditStatus.php` could only ever write 0 or 1, so watch (2) could not be set from the screen. I did not add a second status column. A status is a hold reason, and its effect is 1 stop, 2 watch, anything else normal. That means a customer already on the spreadsheet stop list is loaded by setting their credit status, with no new mechanism (BR-40).

- `CreditStatus.php` now sets the effect from a three-way choice (supply, watch, stop).
- The update adds two codes if they are missing: 90 "Credit Control - On Watch" and 91 "Credit Control - On Stop". A fresh install seeds them (and code 0 "No hold"; a non-demo install had no hold reasons at all, so a customer could not even be created).

## What was built

| Requirement | Where |
|---|---|
| Reviews, history, stop/watch with reason, disputed invoices, exemptions (BR-01 to 05, 08, 18, 20, 32, 33, 34) | `CreditReview.php` (view for everyone who may see the customer, forms only with token 21) |
| Credit control report: reviews due, over limit, watch/stop, held orders; filter by rep and currency; totals in home currency (BR-08, 10, 30) | `CreditControlReport.php` (credit control can release held orders here) |
| Reminder run: preview, leave customers out, escalating stages, email, post list, history (BR-12 to 17) | `CreditDunningRun.php`, stages edited in `CreditControlSetup.php` |
| Month-end interest and late fees, preview and confirm, once per month, waiver (BR-19 to 24) | `CreditCharges.php` |
| Write-off request, approval over the limit, report (BR-25 to 29) | `CreditWriteOffs.php`, `CreditWriteOffReport.php` |
| Ledger agrees with customers, and why not (BR-37, 38) | `CreditDebtorsReconciliation.php` |
| Customer portal (BR-35, 36) | `CustomerCreditAccount.php`, linked from the customer menu in `index.php` |
| Settings (review months, interest rate, fee, grace days, approval limit, minimum days between letters, auto-stop) | `CreditControlSetup.php` (config rows) |
| GL accounts for interest income, fee income, bad debts | `CompanyPreferences.php` (three new `companies` columns, like `freightact`) |
| Shared logic | `includes/CreditControlFunctions.php` |
| Staff guide, sales note (BR-42, 43) | `doc/Manual/ManualCreditControl.html` and its entry in `ManualOutline.php` |

New tables: `creditreviews`, `creditcontrollog` (the audit trail of every action), `dunningstages`, `dunningletters`, `creditcharges` (unique on customer, month, kind, which is what stops a double charge), `creditwriteoffs`. New columns: `debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate/lastreviewdate/interestexempt/feeexempt/dunningexempt`, `debtortrans.disputed`, `salesorders.creditstatus` (0 normal, 1 held, 2 released), `companies.creditinterestact/creditfeeact/baddebtact`. New transaction types: 51 interest/late fee charge, 52 charge waiver, 53 bad debt write-off. They are ordinary `debtortrans` rows with GL, so they show on the account, in the statement, in aged debtors and in the balance without changes to those pages.

## Every way of getting an order in is blocked (BR-06)

The rule lives in one place (`CreditControlOrderCheck`) and is applied where each route saves:

- Sales office and web shop (customer login): `DeliveryDetails.php`, the one place both save. It refuses an order for a customer on stop and holds one that goes over the limit. `SelectOrderItems.php` had a latent bug: a customer login on watch was refused as "on hold"; fixed so watch can still order.
- Standing orders: `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` skips a stopped customer without advancing the template (it raises the order on a later run after the account comes off stop), holds an over-limit order, and does not auto-invoice a held one.
- EDI: `EDIProcessOrders.php` does not create the order for a stopped customer, holds an over-limit one, and says so in its email.
- API: `api_salesorders.php` refuses a header or line for a stopped customer and holds the order when lines take it over the limit; new error codes in `api_errorcodes.php`.
- Dispatch and invoicing: `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` and the API invoice refuse an order that is held, or whose customer is on stop, until credit control releases it (`salesorders.creditstatus = 2`).
- Counter sales already refused a customer on stop; unchanged.

## Other changes made because the feature needs them

- `Customers.php`, `api_customers.php`: only token 21 can change a credit limit or credit status (BR-07). Anyone else keeps what is on file and a new customer gets the default limit and no hold. New customers get a next review date (BR-02). A customer with credit control history cannot be deleted.
- `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` and `Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php` list their tables by hand, so the new tables and columns were added to them.
- `CustomerInquiry.php`, `CustomerAccount.php`: they showed "ACCOUNT ON HOLD" for any non-zero effect, which would have told a customer they were on watch. Watch is now shown to staff only (OQ10), a customer on stop is asked to contact us (BR-11), and the credit status text is hidden from customer logins.
- `SelectCustomer.php`: status banner and link to the review. `AgedDebtors.php`: status, credit limit and last reminder stage (BR-31).
- `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php` reads `chartdetails`, which update 20 dropped, and only covers types 10 to 12, so it could not be reused for BR-37. The new reconciliation uses `gltrans` by type.

## Installation and upgrade (BR-39, 40)

`sql/updates/44.php` does everything with the project's helpers and is safe to rerun. Each statement has a twin in `install/sql/tables` and `install/sql/data` (tables, config, systypes, hold reasons, security tokens and roles, scripts, menu for all nine roles, default letters). The update ends with the usual `Errors == 0` guard. The `session.php` redirect makes the upgrade run for existing databases, including the demo database, since the demo load keeps its own update number. Every existing customer gets a next review date 12 months out; nobody's status is changed. The legacy `sql/mysql/upgrade*.sql` files were not touched (they stop at 4.15 and are not used by the numbered system).

## Decisions on the open questions

1. Interest: a simple annual rate, charged monthly at one twelfth on invoices overdue by more than the grace days. One rate for all currencies and countries.
2. Late fee: one flat fee per customer per month, set in the home currency and converted to the customer's currency.
3. No interest on interest or fees; interest is only on invoices. Fees and interest still appear in reminders.
4. After the final notice the customer is flagged only. A setting (`DunningAutoStop`, off) turns on automatic stop.
5. Over-limit orders from any route are held, not rejected. This only applies while `CheckCreditLimits` is 1 or 2; if the business has it at 0 the system does what it was told.
6. Approval limit is 1,000 in home currency by default, set in the setup. The Financial Accountant does not sign off; token 22 does.
7. A debt paid after write-off is an ordinary receipt (unallocated on the account). The write-offs report and the history keep the record.
8. Reps see the reason for a stop (it is the status description).
9. Letters are English; the wording is editable per stage but there is no per-language wording.
10. The portal does not show watch, nor does it show the status or reason at all, only that the account is on hold.
11. Whoever holds token 21 acts; if both are away, give the token to a third person's role. No code for this.
12. Branches share one credit limit: the limit is on the customer (`debtorsmaster`), not the branch. There is no head-office group in webERP, so groups are not modelled.

Tokens: 21 (credit control) goes to the Accountant and System Administrator roles, 22 (approval) to System Administrator. Real deployments should give them to the credit controller, deputy and Finance Director roles. Reminder letters go to the customer's contacts flagged to receive statements; there is no separate "accounts contact" field.

## Things to know

- Interest, fees and write-offs are not taxed. If the terms make interest taxable that needs adding.
- The write-off is allocated to the oldest open items first. Exchange differences against the invoice rates go to the existing sales exchange variances account.
- The reminder run recomputes who gets a letter at send time, so a customer who paid in between, or moved stage, is skipped.
- `EDIProcessOrders.php` still has `if ($CreateOrder = true)` (an assignment), so it creates orders even for the other errors it detects. I left it alone and added the credit check as a separate guard.
- The API only honours the credit-limit and status guard if the API login carries token 21 in the session; I did not verify that `LoginAPI` loads the security array.
- Language files (`.po`) were not regenerated for the new strings.

## Not verified

Nothing was executed. In particular: PHP syntax of the new pages, the SQL (generated columns and the new unique key), the update on a populated database, the install seed files (they were appended as extra statements), and the exact HTML layout. Run `tests/run/BBB_SinglePageTest.php` (it requests every root page), install with and without demo data, run update 44 on a copy of live data, and walk through AC-01 to AC-11 before release.

webERP already has a credit status: `debtorsmaster.holdreason` pointing at `holdreasons`, and `holdreasons.dissallowinvoices` says what it does. | Write-off request, approval over the limit, report (BR-25 to 29) | `CreditWriteOffs.php`, `CreditWriteOffReport.php` |
| Ledger agrees with customers, and why not (BR-37, 38) | `CreditDebtorsReconciliation.php` |
| Customer portal (BR-35, 36) | `CustomerCreditAccount.php`, linked from the customer menu in `index.php` |

I built the credit control feature, but none of it has been run: the session had no shell or database. PHP syntax, the SQL, the update on a populated database and the page layouts are all unchecked. I read the map first, as required.

`NOTES.md` at the repository root covers what I built and where, the other files I changed, and my answers to the 12 open questions.

- **Credit status:** webERP already had one, as the customer's hold reason, with an effect of stop or watch. I used that instead of adding a second field. `CreditStatus.php` can now actually set "watch". The upgrade adds two codes (90 on watch, 91 on stop). Customers already on the spreadsheet stop list are loaded by setting their credit status.
- **New pages:**
  - `CreditReview.php` records reviews, stop or watch changes, disputed invoices and exemptions, and shows the full history.
  - `CreditControlReport.php` lists reviews due, customers over their limit, customers on watch or stop, and held orders.
  - `CreditDunningRun.php` previews and sends the reminder letters; the letter wording is edited in `CreditControlSetup.php`.
  - `CreditCharges.php` previews and posts month-end interest and late fees, and waives them.
  - `CreditWriteOffs.php` and `CreditWriteOffReport.php` handle write-offs, with Finance Director approval over the limit.
  - `CreditDebtorsReconciliation.php` compares the customer accounts to the debtors control account by transaction type.
  - `CustomerCreditAccount.php` is the customer portal page.
  - Interest, fees, waivers and write-offs are ordinary customer transactions (types 51–53) posted to the ledger, so statements and aged debtors pick them up.
- **Stop is enforced on every route:**
  - `DeliveryDetails.php` covers the sales office and web shop; standing orders, EDI intake and the API are covered too.
  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` and the API invoice also refuse a stopped customer's order.
  - An order that takes a customer over their limit is held until credit control releases it.
- **Other changes the feature needed:**
  - Only credit control can change a limit or status (`Customers.php` and the API).
  - New customers get a first review date.
  - Customers on watch were being blocked from ordering on their own login; fixed.
  - The customer account pages no longer tell a customer they are on watch.
  - The two customer/GL-account rename utilities now include the new tables and columns.
- **Installation:**
  - `sql/updates/44.php` upgrades live systems, and every change is mirrored in the install tables and seed data.
  - Every existing customer gets a next review date 12 months out.
  - The staff guide has a new Credit Control chapter.
  - Two new security tokens: 21 for credit control and 22 for write-off approval.

- **Credit limit setting:** over-limit holding only applies while the existing `CheckCreditLimits` setting is on.
- **EDI intake:** `EDIProcessOrders.php` still has its existing bug that creates orders despite other errors; I left it and added the stop check separately.
- **API login:** I did not confirm the API login carries token 21, so the API limit guard may reject legitimate callers.
- **Translations:** the `.po` files were not regenerated.

Before shipping:
- Run `tests/run/BBB_SinglePageTest.php`.
- Install with and without demo data.
- Run update 44 on a copy of live data.
- Walk through acceptance criteria AC-01 to AC-11.
